title: Cadet Civil Drafter
abstract: ATC Williams is seeking a full-time Cadet Civil Drafter in Brisbane to prepare civil drawings and assist with mining and waste projects. Apply now!
screening_questions: What is your salary expectation (base per annum) for this role?
Do you have working rights in Australia?
Will you require visa sponsorship in the future?
content_text:
CREATE YOUR FUTURE AT ATC WILLIAMS!
About Us:
Renowned for our technical excellence, ATC Williams provides Tailings, Water, and Waste Management services to the mining, resources, and governments sectors. We are a leading specialised engineering and consulting firm with 45 years of successful service to our clients. With eight national office locations and a broad variety of international projects, we offer exciting and sustainable career pathways, whether you are a technical or professional leader, or just starting out in your career.
Why Join Us?
You will be joining our team at an exciting time as ATC Williams continue to solidify our position as a trusted and recognised engineering brand. We are embarking on a significant growth phase, represented by expansion in office locations, employees, opportunities, and capabilities.
About the Role:
We are continually looking for enthusiastic and talented people to join our team.
Our Brisbane, Queensland office is currently seeking a Cadet Civil Drafter on a permanent, full-time basis.
Key Responsibilities and Activities Include:
- Prepare and update civil drawings for waste, water and mining projects under supervision.
- Assist with drawing production using AutoCAD.
- Prepare figures, sketches and plans for reports and proposals.
- Assist with quantity take-offs and bills of quantities.
- Maintain drawings in accordance with ATCW CADD standards and document-control requirements.
- Undertake basic engineering and design-support tasks under supervision.
Knowledge, Experience and Skill Requirements Include:
- Diploma or Associate Degree in Civil Engineering, either recently completed or nearing completion.
- Basic AutoCAD capability, with a willingness to develop proficiency in general civil drafting.
- Good attention to detail and willingness to follow established drafting standards.
- Clear communication skills and the ability to seek guidance.
- Motivation to build a long-term career in civil drafting and design.
- A White Card and current driver’s licence (desired, not essential).
What You Gain when you Join ATC Williams
As an entirely employee-owned organisation with a retention rate to be proud of, our talented and skilled people acknowledge two key reasons why they choose to stay at ATC Williams:
- The depth and generosity of our in-house knowledge and expertise, and
- The fantastic opportunities available for personal growth and diverse project experiences, especially if you are prepared to grab these opportunities with both hands.
Employee Benefits Include:
- Competitive remuneration package.
- Employee-owned company.
- Career and personal development opportunities & mentoring.
- Company paid parental leave.
- Flexible working arrangements available as required.
At ATC Williams, we champion diversity, inclusion, integrity, and equal employment opportunities.
We encourage you to create your future at ATC Williams.
To apply, please provide a cover letter and CV as one attachment to your application and include:
- Rights to work in Australia (essential).
- Base Salary Package expectations.
- Why you have applied for this role.
- Share your career aspirations with us.
Applications close Thursday, 15 October 2026.
Please note ATC Williams does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruiters or employment agencies.
